name: Chladni
author: Trance
description: Sand on a metal plate that a bow sets ringing. The grains are thrown on from the edges and run to where the plate holds still, drawing its figure; the cymbals shake it harder, and every sixteen beats the note changes and the sand runs off to a new figure. The shaking itself is drawn faintly underneath.
frame:
md = mod(floor(beats/16), 5)
m1 = 1 + mod(md, 3)
m2 = m1 + 2 + mod(md, 2)*2
k = 0.0004 + 0.0006*min(treb_att, 2)
pixel:
u = x/0.92*pi
w = y/0.92*pi
in = step(abs(x), 0.92)*step(abs(y), 0.92)
A = cos(m1*u)*cos(m2*w) - cos(m2*u)*cos(m1*w)
ax = -m1*sin(m1*u)*cos(m2*w) + m2*sin(m2*u)*cos(m1*w)
ay = -m2*cos(m1*u)*sin(m2*w) + m1*cos(m2*u)*sin(m1*w)
dx = -k*A*ax*in
dy = -k*A*ay*in
